mappings.note: Always-erect image for all distances identifies plane or convex mirror; qualitative image outcome.
Convex-mirror image is always virtual, erect and behind the mirror; image-location outcome.
Stem is garbled (the real/virtual and size clauses contradict) but it is plainly the concave-versus-convex image-size item; qualitative mirror image outcome.
A medium of higher refractive index is optically denser; refractive index, which LO-3 defines.
Twinkling is atmospheric refraction; the refraction outcome. Note this is Human Eye chapter content sitting in a Light chapter.
A real point-sized image at the focus of a convex lens means the object is at infinity; lens image-position outcome.
Unit of lens power; power reaches no outcome, so competency level.
f = R/2 arithmetic. Duplicate stem of qid:104942 and qid:86613.

Rarer to denser means bending towards the normal; law of refraction.
Range of images a convex lens can form across object positions; lens image-position outcome.
